resources.string: Removes the ads and Super offers shown after lessons.
Turns off Adjust, and Sentry with its crash reports and session replays.
Never asks you to rate the app after a lesson.
Removes the screens that ask or force you to update the app.
Keeps the regular launcher icon instead of the streak and seasonal icons Duolingo swaps in.
Adds the Debug options button to the bottom of Settings and lists every category in Duolingo\'s staff debug menu.
Gives you unlimited energy, so lessons and mistakes never use it up.
Keeps your hearts full in Legendary levels and Jump here tests, so mistakes never end them.
